neighbours.label: ' followed' in a ranking or sequence 'X, followed by Y' (also ' further')
fire: Germany won the most medals at the games, followed by Norway and Canada.
The storm brought heavy rain in the morning, followed by strong winds at night.
Rice is the main crop in the region, followed by maize and beans.
The ceremony opened with a speech by the mayor, followed by a short concert.
Tourism is the largest employer on the island, followed closely by fishing.
The patient first felt a sharp pain, followed by numbness in her arm.
The new policy was further weakened by a series of court rulings.
English is the most spoken language in the city, followed by Spanish.
quiet: Germany won the most medals at the games, and Norway came second.
The storm brought heavy rain in the morning and strong winds at night.
Rice is the main crop in the region, while maize and beans are also grown.
The ceremony opened with a speech by the mayor and ended with a concert.
Tourism is the largest employer on the island, ahead of fishing.
The patient first felt a sharp pain and then numbness in her arm.
The new policy was badly weakened by a series of court rulings.
English is the most spoken language in the city, then Spanish.
